name: dl3dv_bench_torch_960
description: dl3dv_bench_torch_960 is a PyTorch-formatted benchmark dataset intended for evaluating 3D computer-vision models across 960 examples. It provides standardized data and splits for common 3D perception tasks (e.g., depth estimation, pose/shape reconstruction) to enable reproducible comparison of models. The dataset is packaged for easy use in PyTorch-based training and evaluation pipelines.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted benchmark for 3D vision with limited broad community adoption to date.
